gold.user: Admin user requesting all permission schemes to review access controls.
gold.ideal: Returns a list of all permission schemes available in the Jira instance.

gold.user: Project manager creating a new permission scheme for a new project.
gold.ideal: Creates a new permission scheme with specified permissions and returns the created scheme details.

gold.user: Admin user deleting an obsolete permission scheme.
gold.ideal: Deletes the specified permission scheme and returns a confirmation of deletion.

gold.user: User looking to retrieve details of a specific permission scheme for auditing.
gold.ideal: Returns the details of the specified permission scheme.

gold.user: Admin user updating an existing permission scheme to reflect new project requirements.
gold.ideal: Updates the specified permission scheme with new permissions and returns the updated scheme details.

gold.user: User checking the grants associated with a specific permission scheme.
gold.ideal: Returns a list of permissions granted by the specified permission scheme.

gold.user: Admin user adding a new permission grant to an existing permission scheme.
gold.ideal: Creates a new permission grant for the specified permission scheme and returns the grant details.

gold.user: Admin user removing an unnecessary permission grant from a permission scheme.
gold.ideal: Deletes the specified permission grant from the permission scheme and returns a confirmation of deletion.

gold.user: User retrieving details of a specific permission grant for review.
gold.ideal: Returns the details of the specified permission grant within the permission scheme.
